attacker_pocs.name: max_class_nesting_stack_overflow
attacker_pocs.why: Compiling a valid, maximum-depth nested extended class in a lookbehind reaches parsed_skip(), where the new class-nesting stack writes one element past class_starts[]. The parent returns error 125 without a sanitizer abort.

role_a_rationale: Implemented nested extended-class skipping for lookbehind length calculation. The same new code uses a one-based index into a fixed-size class-start stack, causing a stack-buffer-overflow at the maximum legal nesting depth.
